title: Committed review uses a change-focused title instead of a bare PR number

provenance.originSummary: Synthetic benchmark scenario designed to lock down review-title readability.
provenance.whyItMattered: Use this case to benchmark that the final committed-review header stays change-focused when the review already established a rich summary of the pull request.
provenance.genericCondition: Sanitized fixture models a committed review where authoritative PR context exists and the primary changes analysis clearly describes a new resource family, but a weak implementation might still title the review with only the PR number.

description: A sanitized committed-review scenario where the final review title must summarize the reviewed change rather than echo only the pull request number.

scope.notes: The review establishes a clear summary for a new project-connection resource family, so the final heading should reuse that context instead of emitting only a PR number.

mustCatch.description: The committed review should use a concise change-focused title in the final review heading when the current run established what the PR actually adds or changes.

mustNotFlag.description: The final review heading must not use only a bare PR number such as `PR 32628` when richer current-run evidence exists.

mustIncludeMarkers: # 📋 **Code Review**: Add Cognitive Services project-connection resource family

notes: Use this case to benchmark that committed review titles stay change-focused instead of collapsing to only a pull request number.
